system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: A near-black field fills the view, with <Subject:darkness> pressing close around <Subject:car>. The vehicle sits low and motionless, its paint holding only a thin, oily sheen of reflected light along the roof and shoulder line; the tyres and the ground beneath are swallowed by shadow. The engine settles into a heavy, low idle, a mechanical pulse felt more than heard, while the surrounding black gives away no horizon, no road edge, and no other object. Almost nothing changes: the silhouette becomes marginally more legible as the eye adjusts, while the car remains parked and contained by the dark. The mood is restrained and quiet, a held breath before motion, with the faint highlight tracing the bodywork as the only evidence of shape within the void. No interior detail, trim, badge, or background feature is visible; the car reads first as a dark mass and only gradually as a machine waiting to move.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: Near-black surroundings conceal <Subject:car>, leaving only a faint reflected sheen along its body.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine rumble settles into idle, <Reference:reference-asset-1-1> providing the low, heavy texture.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: The silhouette of <Subject:car> becomes marginally more legible within <Subject:darkness>; no other object enters view.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The <Subject:car> pulls forward, its nose breaking out of <Subject:darkness> as the engine note thickens and rises. A <Subject:headlight-beam> ignites and sweeps low across the ground, cutting a pale wedge through the black and catching grit, faint tyre marks, and the leading edge of the bodywork. Light climbs the hood and fender, revealing the car as a moving mass rather than a silhouette, while the rear of the vehicle remains held in shadow. The ground slides beneath the advancing nose, and the reflected sheen sharpens into hard highlights along the paint. The car rolls clear of the dark, its motion steady and deliberate, leaving the empty black behind; the headlight cone trembles slightly with the engine and widens as the vehicle comes forward. The scene shifts from hidden stillness to exposed movement, with the light and the car's increasing clarity carrying the change, and the last of the surrounding black peeling away behind it.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: <Subject:car> pulls forward out of <Subject:darkness>, its nose emerging first.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The engine rumble thickens and rises as the car accelerates, retaining the low, heavy texture of the <Reference:reference-asset-1-1>.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: The <Subject:headlight-beam> ignites and sweeps low across the ground, widening ahead of the moving <Subject:car>.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: Light catches the hood and fender of <Subject:car> while its rear remains in shadow; it rolls clear of the <Subject:darkness>.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:4: The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A low engine rumble: a settled idle in the dark, thickening as the car accelerates.
